{{Quote|Fly with honor and fight with the Emperor's own fury.|Commander Oberhaur|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
'''Oberhaur''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and Imperial Pilot Trainer in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==Biography==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Oberhaur was stationed in the capitol building of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Here, he trained pilots of the [[Storm Squadron/Legends|Storm Squadron]] starfighter unit.

During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Oberhaur met one particular useful pilot. He tasked the pilot with a number of various missions, starting with the disabling and inspection of a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant's]] ship over [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] space. The Lieutenant was a member of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], so Oberhaur was particularly interested in his purpose. After the successful completion of this mission, Oberhaur had the pilot intercept an [[HC-556 Light Cruiser]] which was being used as a hostage transport. Though the pilot was met with some resistance, he succeeded in escorting the cruiser to safety.

Oberhaur had one final task for the pilot, however, and it was much more daring than the previous ones. Oberhaur wanted the pilot to head over to [[Nym's Stronghold]], and speak to an undercover Imperial Agent named [[Morv]]. The agent, disguised as a Nym's Fuel Technician, tasked the pilot with destroying a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]] named the ''[[Kimogila's Claw]]''. The pilot once again succeeded, and returned to Oberhaur, expecting another task. While Oberhaur was pleased with the pilot's work, he had no other use for him. Oberhaur reassigned the pilot to [[Field Commander/Legends|Field Commander]] [[Alozen]], so that the pilot could continue his future in the Imperial Navy.

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Oberhaur is a [[Wikipedia:non-player character|Non-Player Character]] in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Players progressing through the Imperial Storm Squadron must work for Oberhaur, so that they can gain experience and progress through the Imperial Pilot Profession.
